notes: The relaunch's own premiere broadcast — an interview-and-promo show with no matches of its own, closing on Dave Shaw's own announcement of a 24-man, eight-bracket SEWF World Heavyweight Championship tournament (three-way first-round bouts). None of the eight Round 1 bouts this broadcast announces is itself served anywhere in the held record; SEWF Sunday Night Mothership, 20 August 2000 opens directly on four Round 2 matches, whose entrants (Wyatt Wallace, Silky Slim, Omega, Burt Clifton, Simon Southward, Higor Rosa, Jay Lange, Jack Paine) imply each one's own Round 1 result without narrating it. Ryan Stevens' own interview on that later show additionally recounts, second-hand, that he lost his Round 1 bout to Simon Southward with Blackheart's own pipe interference — the fullest surviving account of any Round 1 outcome, though not a primary transcript of the bout itself. Ray Hagan interrupts the broadcast to claim an unbroken SEWF World Heavyweight Championship reign carried over from the original, unheld c. 1996 run, forcing Dave Shaw to add a unification stipulation to the tournament final at ShawCade 3 (also not held).

Solkoff works the neck, then makes Collins tap to a camel clutch.
Kain schoolboys Jacobs while Jacobs argues with the referee about a quick count.
Clifton, now openly cheating, wins with a frog splash with his feet on the ropes.

Bruno Mancini rouses Blade; Reckless Abandon, revealing himself as EWWF, puts Blade through a table and lays Blade on Blake for the pin, but on Simon Solkoff's protest the decision is reversed and Blake keeps the title by disqualification.

date.source: The broadcast's own subject line and posting date.

appearances.note: Threatens to fire Jack Paine, then takes Ray Hagan's million-dollar wager that Paine will win at the pay-per-view; later discloses the Junior Heavyweight tournament teams.
Visits Ray Hagan for help in a taped segment.
No longer an SEWF member; takes Jack Paine in to train him.
Appointed commissioner of the EWWF by Simon Solkoff.
Backstage interview before his semi-final.
Cuts Burt Clifton open and warns him from the stands.
Names Tommy Kain the number-two contender and offers him Toshiro Kasai in two weeks.

matches.note: Sanders blinds Blade with green mist and mace behind the referee's back and wins with "It's Over"; Art Blake then knocks Blade unconscious with a lead pipe and Blade is taken to hospital.
Smoove and Justin Blade come to ringside; Trineo wins with the flying Trineo Destroyer out of nowhere.
Robinson attacks before the bell; Gionet wins with the Legendary.
Syko attacks from the crowd; Smoove steals the win with a swinging DDT, a modified Groove.
Kofford's first match. Steve Carey lures Kofford into an ambush; Kofford is disqualified for ring-bell shots to Carey and Miller and is led away in handcuffs.
A corkscrew Stargazer through a table, then the Seeing Stars superkick for the pin.
Solkoff, in an EWWF shirt, advances to the final and serves Kane with a restraining order.
Toshiro Kasai and Nathan Hunter, Narcissa's new hires, hold down Kain's legs for the pin; Masked Man 111 then mists Clifton and cuts him open.

name: SEWF Mothership, 26 November 2001

date.source: The broadcast's own subject line and posting date.

notes: Opens with a short out-of-character note from the writer.

appearances.note: Names the 10 December pay-per-view End Game, then is kidnapped by Masked Man 111 and held on Caseyvision for the rest of the show; he cancels Jack Paine against Larry Gionet to give his captor air time.
Holds Thomas Casey captive, makes him sign documents, kidnaps Matt Hammer and takes over the closing Hammerlock as "Mister One".
Gives up the United States title to a five-man brawl whose winner must sign with the EWWF.
Kidnapped at gunpoint in the parking lot.
Returns to lay out Simon Solkoff with the Confederate Crush.

matches.stipulation: four-on-four elimination match, first round of the World Junior Heavyweight Championship tournament
matches.note: Team 1 against Team 4. Kofford and Miller refuse to work together; Kasai and Hunter are counted out, and Kain, with Trineo, survives for Team 1. Afterwards Jay Miller and Steve Carey beat Kofford with the ring bell.

matches.stipulation: four-on-four elimination match, first round of the World Junior Heavyweight Championship tournament
matches.note: Team 2 against Team 3. Rapidfire's debut. Ryan Sanders, left alone against four, eliminates The Torturer and Syko before Clifton and Solkoff, arguing throughout, finish him; Narcissa holds Solkoff's leg on the last cover.

name: SEWF End Game

date.source: The broadcast's own billing and posting date.

notes: Posted the morning after, 11 December 2001.

Paine's trainer; Sterling Carnegie pays his million-dollar wager and makes him President of the EWWF.
Announces that he has invested in the EWWF.
EWWF commissioner.

matches.stipulation: four-way elimination match for the first SEWF World Junior Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Solkoff schoolboys Trineo with a handful of tights, Kasai makes the injured Kain submit to a surfboard, and Solkoff wins the title with a crucifix powerbomb after Michael Lavender hops the rail and hits him with a chair.
Kofford attacks with a chair before the bell and the match never properly starts; a Santa Claus throws fire in his face and Steve Carey announces the return of the Outpatients.

matches.stipulation: SEWF Extreme/Television Championship, a "highflyer match" of the champion's choosing
matches.note: Jacobs, champion since taking the title from Smoove the week before, picks the stipulation; Ray Hagan seconds Paine. Smoove's elbow drop into the wreckage of the announce table wins back the title.

matches.stipulation: five-way elimination inside the Thunderdome for the SEWF United States Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Art Blake's brawl for the title he gave up, the winner to sign with the EWWF. Zeke pins Vernon Patterson, and Magnus Colby pins Zeke and then the actress Alicia Witt, until Thomas Casey adds Trineo del Abanico, who pins Colby, refuses the EWWF contract and unmasks as Johnny Sledge.

matches.stipulation: Tag Team Turmoil for the SEWF World Tag Team Championship
matches.note: Reckless Abandon and Jeff Kane come in as champions. With Hunter and Reed both covering, Kasai pulls Reed off Reckless Abandon and Hunter pins Robinson, and the Kasai Contingent take the titles back to Narcissa.

matches.stipulation: best two out of three falls for the SEWF World Heavyweight Championship, the tournament final
matches.note: Clifton takes the first fall by disqualification when Solkoff refuses to release a Texas cloverleaf, and Solkoff takes the second. Thomas Casey has a Solkoff pin overturned, and Ray Hagan has Clifton's loaded-sock pin overturned, before Clifton wins with the frog splash to become World Heavyweight Champion.

Ramirez flattens the referee with a clothesline meant for Jones; Bronson Johnson debuts by laying both men out, Larry Gionet runs him off, and the recovered referee calls for the bell.

matches.stipulation: number one contendership to the World Junior Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Despair smiles through every hold and is put out by the O.D. dragon sleeper.
A double debut; Venom reverses a Northern Lights suplex into a standing tornado DDT.
Clifton wins with the Clifton Bomb, then is chaired and Grooved by Smoove while Simon Solkoff talks; Solkoff is pushed into making the cover, and a four-man brawl follows.
Collins counters the Payne Killer into the Cocktail Shaker for his second win since returning.

Billed for the card and cancelled from the office before the bell.

Love takes his debut match with the LovePlex after Collins misses the Cocktail Shaker.
The two go through the announce table; Clifton taps to the O.D. after the Stoner.
Kontani small-packages the champion out of a second Groove to take the title.
Kain and Gionet break each other's covers until Mitchell hits the Marksman on Kain and pins Gionet.

matches.stipulation: grudge match inside a twenty-foot steel cage

matches.stipulation: Taipei death match with barbed-wire ropes

Morrison does not come round afterwards; Kain puts the title down and gives him CPR until the paramedics take over, and is chaired by Tom Collins as he weeps in the ring.
Kontani crucifix-powerbombs Roberts from the ladder to the floor and climbs for the belt.

matches.stipulation: tables, ladders and chairs for a number one contender's contract
matches.note: Solkoff sunset-flips Syko off the ladder and over the top rope onto the announce table; Syko is taken out on a backboard and the contract is never shown taken down.
Smoove wins by disqualification when Mitchell uses a pair of pliers, so Mitchell keeps the title; Mitchell then handcuffs him to the ropes and Simon Solkoff throws himself in the way.
